lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgTaO₄ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 12 atoms (Mg₂Ta₂O₈) distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ta centers in an octahedral environment with six O neighbors, while Mg centers have eight O neighbors in a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement. The O-centered environments involve three Ta neighbors or two Mg and one Ta neighbor. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 12 sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Ta octahedra.
